correctness.rationale: The curve is smooth and irreducible; the power map to the conic is a degree d^3 Galois diagonal cover. S4-invariants of the conic give weighted generators e3,e4 and a degree-24 quotient. The disjoint zero divisors of e3,e4 and quartic discriminant have precisely 6,8,12 simple geometric points and ramification indices 4,3,2. The coordinate cover ramifies only over e4=0, multiplying the pole index by d. Riemann–Hurwitz gives the adjunction genus, and the published Theorem 3.6 gives the entire automorphism group, so there is no larger deck group. The bundled SymPy verifier passed on symbolic identities and integer arithmetic; these are not treated as a substitute for universal geometric proof.

value.rationale: Exact full-automorphism quotient, all three branch orders, degree and genus identify an infinite natural family of regular dessins associated with recently classified automorphism-rich algebraic curves. The 3d branch index arises from the interaction of two different quotient operations and is not merely a restatement of the full group order. The explicit function is defined over Q and supplies a concrete moduli/triangle-group invariant.
